subject: correct r squares in nonrecursive observed variable models

messages.author: fd248aedd6f929a2
messages.subject: correct r squares in nonrecursive observed variable models
parts:
Analyzing data from a simulated randomized experiment with reciprocal effect. The treatment variable affords me with an excellent instrumental variable. Also, simulation includes orthogonal covariates, which provide model DF for detecting misspecifications.

I know that the R2s reported by lavaan in this situation are incorrect. Is there a straightforward way to compute the correct R2s?

Thanks,
Jim Grace

messages.author: 99a06696c483481a
messages.subject: RE: correct r squares in nonrecursive observed variable models
parts:
Jim—

     With reciprocal relations, the very concept of R2 is broken—you cannot uniquely distinguish explained variance from unexplained variance. Les Hayduk’s block R2 is often used. It doesn’t solve the fundamental problem, but it produces a value between 0 and 1, while an ordinary R2 formula can yield values well outside that range.

 

https://link.springer.com/content/pdf/10.1007/s11135-005-1095-4.pdf
